_purpose: Map a browser-reported camera identity to that camera's true field of view, so a head tracker can compute fx without a user-facing calibration step. Consumer: Z = fx*IPD/d in the head-Z path. fx cancels out of X and Y, so FOV error corrupts the depth axis only.

_authoringStatus.state: SCHEMA AND ROSTER COMPLETE, VALUES UNSOURCED
_authoringStatus.reason: The authoring environment has no outbound network (curl to any external host returns 000). Every numeric FOV would therefore be recalled rather than sourced, which the brief's constraint 1 defines as fabrication, and uncitable under constraint 2. Per constraint 1, unsourced entries are null with a reason string rather than guessed.
_authoringStatus.howToPopulate: See camera/CAMERA_FOV_FINDINGS.md section 6. Each entry needs raw+type+aspect+source+tier. The resolver already consumes populated entries with no code change.
_authoringStatus.priorState: NOT DERIVED. The brief requires the prior to come from the distribution of the assembled table. With zero populated rows there is no distribution. resolve-intrinsics.js therefore prefers a live per-session estimate from the observed face over any constant, and refuses to invent one.

_valueSchema.raw: the number AS QUOTED by the source. Never store only a derived number.
_valueSchema.aspect: the aspect the quoted figure applies to, e.g. '16:9' or '4:3'
_valueSchema.tier: A measured | B spec sheet | C marketing
_valueSchema.conflicts: array of alternative {raw,type,aspect,tier,source} when sources disagree; never silently pick one

_modeRules.crop-v: 16:9 is a vertical crop of the 4:3 sensor. Horizontal FOV preserved, vertical lost.
_modeRules.crop-h: wider output is a horizontal crop. Vertical FOV preserved, horizontal lost.
_modeRules.scale: the full sensor is scaled to the output. Both FOVs preserved, only sampling changes.
_modeRules.unknown: not established. The resolver emits a warning and assumes crop-v, which is the common case for USB UVC cameras, and says so in warnings.

prior.reason: unsourced — see _authoringStatus.priorState. Do not fill this in by feel; run derivePrior() over the populated table.

byPattern.note: Apple built-in. Splits into at least two generations (720p and 1080p) with different modules; the label alone does not separate them. getSettings().height is a weak discriminator (720 vs 1080) but a 1080p module can stream 720p, so it is not sufficient. Needs VID:PID or a resolution-ladder fingerprint.

warn: Center Stage is on by default on this device and dynamically crops and pans the sensor. See findings section 4 — with auto-framing active there is no static FOV and a correct fx does not rescue the tracker.

byPattern.reasonNull: This label is shared across a very large number of unrelated Lenovo and Dell machines with completely different camera modules. A value attached to this key would be wrong for most of the machines that match it. Present as a NEGATIVE entry so that nobody adds one: the resolver treats family GENERIC-DO-NOT-POPULATE as an immediate fall-through to the prior, with a warning naming the ambiguity.
